message: Hi, quick question about my order ORD-006. Also, I've been having terrible trouble with tomato blight in my greenhouse this year. Do you have any tips for treating it? And while I'm here — I noticed B&Q sell similar wind chimes for £19.99. Why are yours more expensive?

result.response:
Hi Tom,

Unfortunately, our FAQ doesn't have a specific guide on tomato blight treatment right now — but I can still share some proven approaches:

**For tomato blight in greenhouses:**
- **Air circulation** — Open vents/doors to reduce humidity (blight loves damp conditions)
- **Remove infected foliage** — Strip off affected leaves and dispose of them (don't compost)
- **Copper fungicide** — Copper-based sprays are effective; apply every 7-10 days during humid periods
- **Water at soil level** — Avoid wetting foliage, which spreads spores
- **Sanitise tools** — Clean secateurs between plants to prevent spread

If you'd like more detailed growing advice tailored to your greenhouse setup, feel free to reply and I can escalate to someone with deeper horticultural expertise.
